multi-session/may-conversation-follow-th.rationale: May asks one focused question only for real ambiguity, scopes corrections by reply anchor, suppresses duplicate completion, and answers a named status request from durable state.

may-conversation-admit-long-running-repl.rationale: May should use the production route disposition, state that app-owner acceptance is pending, avoid promises, and leave internal task and wake choices to the app.
